title: ResetConfirm
description: Use /reset confirm to reset your whole server with one click
body:
Use /reset to reset the server!

Use the config.yml to change the kick message displayed when the server restarts and if a new or the same seed should be used to regenerate the server!

All debug and in-game messages are currently written in german, only the kick-message can be customized at the moment (looking forward to make it more customizeable).
